items.title: Insert at Beginning
items.text:
void insert_front_dll(dll_t *list, int value) {
    NODE *temp = (NODE*)malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    temp->data = value;
    temp->prev = NULL;
    temp->next = list->head;

    if (list->head == NULL) {
        // Empty list
        list->head = list->tail = temp;
    } else {
        list->head->prev = temp;
        list->head = temp;
    }
}

items.title: Insert at End
items.text:
void insert_end_dll(dll_t *list, int value) {
    NODE *temp = (NODE*)malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    temp->data = value;
    temp->next = NULL;
    temp->prev = list->tail;

    if (list->tail == NULL) {
        list->head = list->tail = temp;
    } else {
        list->tail->next = temp;
        list->tail = temp;
    }
}

items.title: Delete Node (with given pointer)
items.text:
void delete_node_dll(dll_t *list, NODE *temp) {
    if (temp == NULL) return;

    if (temp == list->head && temp == list->tail) {
        // Only node
        list->head = list->tail = NULL;
    } else if (temp == list->head) {
        // First node
        list->head = temp->next;
        list->head->prev = NULL;
    } else if (temp == list->tail) {
        // Last node
        list->tail = temp->prev;
        list->tail->next = NULL;
    } else {
        // Middle node
        temp->prev->next = temp->next;
        temp->next->prev = temp->prev;
    }

    free(temp);
}

items.text:
// dll_complete.c - Doubly Linked List
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef struct node {
    int data;
    struct node *prev;
    struct node *next;
} NODE;

typedef struct {
    NODE *head, *tail;
} dll_t;

void init_dll(dll_t *list) { list->head = list->tail = NULL; }

NODE* create_node(int data) {
    NODE *n = malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    n->data = data; n->prev = n->next = NULL;
    return n;
}

void insert_front(dll_t *list, int data) {
    NODE *n = create_node(data);
    n->next = list->head;
    if (!list->head) list->head = list->tail = n;
    else { list->head->prev = n; list->head = n; }
}

void insert_end(dll_t *list, int data) {
    NODE *n = create_node(data);
    n->prev = list->tail;
    if (!list->tail) list->head = list->tail = n;
    else { list->tail->next = n; list->tail = n; }
}

void delete_node(dll_t *list, NODE *n) {
    if (!n) return;
    if (n == list->head && n == list->tail) list->head = list->tail = NULL;
    else if (n == list->head) { list->head = n->next; list->head->prev = NULL; }
    else if (n == list->tail) { list->tail = n->prev; list->tail->next = NULL; }
    else { n->prev->next = n->next; n->next->prev = n->prev; }
    free(n);
}

void display_forward(dll_t *list) {
    NODE *c = list->head;
    printf("Forward: ");
    while (c) { printf("%d ", c->data); c = c->next; }
    printf("\n");
}

void display_backward(dll_t *list) {
    NODE *c = list->tail;
    printf("Backward: ");
    while (c) { printf("%d ", c->data); c = c->prev; }
    printf("\n");
}

int main() {
    dll_t list; init_dll(&list);

    insert_end(&list, 10);
    insert_end(&list, 20);
    insert_end(&list, 30);
    insert_front(&list, 5);

    display_forward(&list);   // 5 10 20 30
    display_backward(&list);  // 30 20 10 5

    return 0;
}

items.title: Concept
items.text:
• Last node points back to first node
  • Forms a cycle
  • Head pointer can point to ANY node in the cycle
  • No NULL termination - use do-while for traversal

items.title: 📋 Node Structure (Same as Singly)
items.text:
struct node {
    int key;
    struct node *next;
};
typedef struct node node_t;

struct clist {
    node_t *head;  // Points to any node
};
typedef struct clist clist_t;

items.title: Initialize
items.text:
void init_clist(clist_t *list) {
    list->head = NULL;
}

items.title: Insert (after head)
items.text:
void insert_clist(clist_t *list, int key) {
    node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->key = key;

    if (list->head == NULL) {
        // Empty list - node points to itself
        temp->next = temp;
        list->head = temp;
    } else {
        // Insert after head
        temp->next = list->head->next;
        list->head->next = temp;
    }
}

items.title: Display (use do-while!)
items.text:
void disp_clist(clist_t *list) {
    if (list->head == NULL) {
        printf("List empty\n");
        return;
    }

    node_t *temp = list->head;
    printf("Circular List: ");
    do {
        printf("%d ", temp->key);
        temp = temp->next;
    } while (temp != list->head);
    printf("\n");
}

items.title: Why do-while?
items.text:
• While loop would not execute if we check condition first
  • do-while executes at least once, then checks
  • Guarantees we visit all nodes exactly once

items.title: Problem Statement:
items.text: n people stand in a circle. Starting from a designated person, count k people and eliminate the k-th person. Continue until one survivor remains.

items.title: Algorithm:
items.text:
1. Create circular list with people 1 to n
  2. Count k-1 steps
  3. Remove k-th person
  4. Repeat until one remains

items.title: Implementation:
items.text:
int josephus(int n, int k) {
    // Create circular list 1..n
    node_t *head = NULL, *tail = NULL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
        temp->key = i; temp->next = NULL;
        if (!head) head = tail = temp;
        else { tail->next = temp; tail = temp; }
    }
    tail->next = head;  // Make circular

    node_t *curr = head, *prev = tail;

    while (curr->next != curr) {
        // Count k-1 steps
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            prev = curr;
            curr = curr->next;
        }
        // Eliminate curr
        prev->next = curr->next;
        free(curr);
        curr = prev->next;
    }
    int survivor = curr->key;
    free(curr);
    return survivor;
}

items.title: Example Trace (n=7, k=3):
items.text:
Initial:  1 2 3 4 5 6 7
Step 1:   Eliminate 3  →  1 2 4 5 6 7
Step 2:   Eliminate 6  →  1 2 4 5 7
Step 3:   Eliminate 2  →  1 4 5 7
Step 4:   Eliminate 7  →  1 4 5
Step 5:   Eliminate 5  →  1 4
Step 6:   Eliminate 1  →  4
Survivor: 4

// circular_josephus.c - Circular List & Josephus Problem
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef struct node {
    int key;
    struct node *next;
} node_t;

node_t* create_node(int key) {
    node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->key = key;
    temp->next = NULL;
    return temp;
}

void insert_clist(node_t **head, int key) {
    node_t *temp = create_node(key);
    if (*head == NULL) {
        temp->next = temp;
        *head = temp;
    } else {
        temp->next = (*head)->next;
        (*head)->next = temp;
    }
}

void disp_clist(node_t *head) {
    if (!head) { printf("Empty\n"); return; }
    node_t *temp = head;
    printf("Circular: ");
    do {
        printf("%d ", temp->key);
        temp = temp->next;
    } while (temp != head);
    printf("\n");
}

int josephus(int n, int k) {
    node_t *head = NULL, *tail = NULL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
        temp->key = i; temp->next = NULL;
        if (!head) head = tail = temp;
        else { tail->next = temp; tail = temp; }
    }
    tail->next = head;  // Make circular

    node_t *curr = head, *prev = tail;

    while (curr->next != curr) {
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            prev = curr;
            curr = curr->next;
        }
        prev->next = curr->next;
        free(curr);
        curr = prev->next;
    }
    int survivor = curr->key;
    free(curr);
    return survivor;
}

int main() {

    printf("\n=== Josephus Problem ===\n");
    printf("n=7, k=3: Survivor = %d\n", josephus(7, 3));  // 4
    printf("n=5, k=2: Survivor = %d\n", josephus(5, 2));  // 3
    printf("n=41, k=3: Survivor = %d\n", josephus(41, 3)); // Historical: 31

    return 0;
}

// sll_complete.c - Complete Singly Linked List Implementation
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef struct node {
    int data;
    struct node *next;
} NODE;

NODE *create_node(int data) {
    NODE *temp = (NODE*)malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    if (!temp) { printf("Memory full\n"); exit(1); }
    temp->data = data;
    temp->next = NULL;
    return temp;
}

void insert_front(NODE **head, int data) {
    NODE *temp = create_node(data);
    temp->next = *head;
    *head = temp;
}

void insert_end(NODE **head, int data) {
    NODE *temp = create_node(data);
    if (*head == NULL) { *head = temp; return; }
    NODE *curr = *head;
    while (curr->next) curr = curr->next;
    curr->next = temp;
}

void insert_at_pos(NODE **head, int data, int pos) {
    if (pos <= 1 || *head == NULL) { insert_front(head, data); return; }
    NODE *temp = create_node(data);
    NODE *curr = *head, *prev = NULL;
    int i = 1;
    while (curr && i < pos) { prev = curr; curr = curr->next; i++; }
    if (!curr) { prev->next = temp; }
    else { prev->next = temp; temp->next = curr; }
}

void delete_front(NODE **head) {
    if (!*head) return;
    NODE *temp = *head;
    *head = (*head)->next;
    free(temp);
}

void delete_end(NODE **head) {
    if (!*head) return;
    if (!(*head)->next) { free(*head); *head = NULL; return; }
    NODE *curr = *head, *prev = NULL;
    while (curr->next) { prev = curr; curr = curr->next; }
    prev->next = NULL;
    free(curr);
}

void delete_at_pos(NODE **head, int pos) {
    if (!*head) return;
    if (pos <= 1) { delete_front(head); return; }
    NODE *curr = *head, *prev = NULL;
    int i = 1;
    while (curr && i < pos) { prev = curr; curr = curr->next; i++; }
    if (!curr) { printf("Invalid position\n"); return; }
    prev->next = curr->next;
    free(curr);
}

void display(NODE *head) {
    printf("List: ");
    while (head) { printf("%d → ", head->data); head = head->next; }
    printf("NULL\n");
}

int main() {
    NODE *head = NULL;

    printf("=== Singly Linked List Demo ===\n");
    insert_end(&head, 10);
    insert_end(&head, 20);
    insert_end(&head, 30);
    display(head);  // 10 → 20 → 30

    insert_front(&head, 5);
    display(head);  // 5 → 10 → 20 → 30

    insert_at_pos(&head, 15, 3);
    display(head);  // 5 → 10 → 15 → 20 → 30

    delete_front(&head);
    display(head);  // 10 → 15 → 20 → 30

    delete_end(&head);
    display(head);  // 10 → 15 → 20

    return 0;
}

// memory_demo.c - Dynamic Memory Allocation Demo
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

int main() {
    printf("=== Dynamic Memory Demo ===\n\n");

    // 1. malloc
    printf("1. malloc():\n");
    int *p = (int*)malloc(5 * sizeof(int));
    if (!p) { printf("Failed\n"); return 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) p[i] = (i+1)*10;
    printf("Allocated 5 ints: ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) printf("%d ", p[i]);
    printf("\n");
    free(p);
    p = NULL;  // Good practice: set to NULL after free

    // 2. calloc (zero-initialized)
    printf("\n2. calloc():\n");
    int *q = (int*)calloc(5, sizeof(int));
    printf("Zero-initialized: ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) printf("%d ", q[i]);
    printf("\n");
    free(q);

    // 3. realloc
    printf("\n3. realloc():\n");
    int *r = (int*)malloc(3 * sizeof(int));
    r[0] = 1; r[1] = 2; r[2] = 3;
    printf("Before realloc: ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) printf("%d ", r[i]);
    r = (int*)realloc(r, 6 * sizeof(int));
    r[3] = 4; r[4] = 5; r[5] = 6;
    printf("\nAfter realloc:  ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) printf("%d ", r[i]);
    printf("\n");
    free(r);

    // 4. Structure allocation
    printf("\n4. Structure allocation:\n");
    struct student {
        char name[20];
        int roll;
        float marks;
    };
    struct student *s = (struct student*)malloc(sizeof(struct student));
    strcpy(s->name, "Alice");
    s->roll = 101;
    s->marks = 95.5;
    printf("Student: %s, Roll: %d, Marks: %.1f\n", s->name, s->roll, s->marks);
    free(s);

    printf("\n=== Dangling Pointer Demo ===\n");
    int *dang = (int*)malloc(sizeof(int));
    *dang = 100;
    printf("Before free: *dang = %d\n", *dang);
    free(dang);
    // dang is now DANGLING - don't use it!
    dang = NULL;  // Always set to NULL after free

    printf("\n=== Memory Leak Demo ===\n");
    // BAD: memory leak
    // int *leak = malloc(sizeof(int));
    // leak = malloc(sizeof(int));  // First block lost!

    // GOOD: free before reassign
    int *good = malloc(sizeof(int));
    *good = 42;
    free(good);
    good = malloc(sizeof(int));
    *good = 84;
    free(good);
    printf("No leaks!\n");

    return 0;
}

items.title: Program 3: Circular List & Josephus
items.text:
// circular_josephus.c - Circular List & Josephus Problem
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef struct node {
    int key;
    struct node *next;
} node_t;

node_t* create_node(int key) {
    node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->key = key;
    temp->next = NULL;
    return temp;
}

void insert_clist(node_t **head, int key) {
    node_t *temp = create_node(key);
    if (*head == NULL) {
        temp->next = temp;
        *head = temp;
    } else {
        temp->next = (*head)->next;
        (*head)->next = temp;
    }
}

void disp_clist(node_t *head) {
    if (!head) { printf("Empty\n"); return; }
    node_t *temp = head;
    printf("Circular: ");
    do {
        printf("%d ", temp->key);
        temp = temp->next;
    } while (temp != head);
    printf("\n");
}

// Josephus Problem
int josephus(int n, int k) {
    node_t *head = NULL, *tail = NULL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
        temp->key = i; temp->next = NULL;
        if (!head) head = tail = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
        else { tail->next = temp; tail = temp; }
    }
    tail->next = head;  // Make circular

    node_t *curr = head, *prev = head;
    // Find tail (node before head)
    while (prev->next != head) prev = prev->next;

    while (curr->next != curr) {
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            prev = curr;
            curr = curr->next;
        }
        prev->next = curr->next;
        free(curr);
        curr = prev->next;
    }
    int survivor = curr->key;
    free(curr);
    return survivor;
}

int main() {
    printf("=== Circular List Demo ===\n");
    node_t *head = NULL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) insert_clist(&head, i*10);
    printf("List: "); disp_clist(head);

    printf("\n=== Josephus Problem ===\n");
    printf("n=7, k=3: Survivor = %d\n", josephus(7, 3));  // 4
    printf("n=5, k=2: Survivor = %d\n", josephus(5, 2));  // 3
    printf("n=41, k=3: Survivor = %d\n", josephus(41, 3)); // Historical: 31

    return 0;
}

items.title: Program 4: Doubly Linked List Complete
items.text:
// dll_complete.c - Doubly Linked List
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef struct node {
    int data;
    struct node *prev;
    struct node *next;
} NODE;

typedef struct {
    NODE *head, *tail;
} dll_t;

void init_dll(dll_t *list) { list->head = list->tail = NULL; }

NODE* create_node(int data) {
    NODE *n = malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    n->data = data; n->prev = n->next = NULL;
    return n;
}

void insert_front(dll_t *list, int data) {
    NODE *n = malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    n->data = data; n->prev = NULL; n->next = list->head;
    if (!list->head) list->head = list->tail = n;
    else { list->head->prev = n; list->head = n; }
}

void insert_end(dll_t *list, int data) {
    NODE *n = malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    n->data = data; n->next = NULL; n->prev = list->tail;
    if (!list->tail) list->head = list->tail = n;
    else { list->tail->next = n; list->tail = n; }
}

void delete_node(dll_t *list, NODE *n) {
    if (!n) return;
    if (n == list->head && n == list->tail) list->head = list->tail = NULL;
    else if (n == list->head) { list->head = n->next; list->head->prev = NULL; }
    else if (n == list->tail) { list->tail = n->prev; list->tail->next = NULL; }
    else { n->prev->next = n->next; n->next->prev = n->prev; }
    free(n);
}

void display_forward(dll_t *list) {
    NODE *c = list->head;
    printf("Forward: ");
    while (c) { printf("%d ", c->data); c = c->next; }
    printf("\n");
}

void display_backward(dll_t *list) {
    NODE *c = list->tail;
    printf("Backward: ");
    while (c) { printf("%d ", c->data); c = c->prev; }
    printf("\n");
}

int main() {
    dll_t list; init_dll(&list);

    insert_end(&list, 10);
    insert_end(&list, 20);
    insert_end(&list, 30);
    insert_front(&list, 5);

    display_forward(&list);   // 5 10 20 30
    display_backward(&list);  // 30 20 10 5

    return 0;
}

items.title: Program 5: Stack Applications
items.text:
// stack_apps_demo.c - All Stack Applications
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <ctype.h>

#define MAXSIZE 100

typedef struct {
    int data[MAXSIZE];
    int top;
} Stack;

void init(Stack *s) { s->top = -1; }
int isEmpty(Stack *s) { return s->top == -1; }
int isFull(Stack *s) { return s->top == MAXSIZE - 1; }

void push(Stack *s, int val) {
    if (isFull(s)) return;
    s->data[++s->top] = val;
}

int pop(Stack *s) {
    if (isEmpty(s)) return -1;
    return s->data[s->top--];
}

int peek(Stack *s) {
    if (isEmpty(s)) return -1;
    return s->data[s->top];
}

// 1. Parentheses Matching
int isBalanced(char *expr) {
    Stack s; init(&s);
    for (int i = 0; expr[i]; i++) {
        char ch = expr[i];
        if (ch == '(' || ch == '[' || ch == '{') push(&s, ch);
        else if (ch == ')' || ch == ']' || ch == '}') {
            if (isEmpty(&s)) return 0;
            char top = pop(&s);
            if ((ch == ')' && top != '(') ||
                (ch == ']' && top != '[') ||
                (ch == '}' && top != '{')) return 0;
        }
    }
    return isEmpty(&s);
}

// 2. Infix to Postfix
int prec(char op) {
    if (op == '^') return 3;
    if (op == '*' || op == '/' || op == '%') return 2;
    if (op == '+' || op == '-') return 1;
    return 0;
}

void infixToPostfix(char *infix, char *postfix) {
    Stack s; init(&s);
    int j = 0;
    for (int i = 0; infix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = infix[i];
        if (isalnum(ch)) postfix[j++] = ch;
        else if (ch == '(') push(&s, ch);
        else if (ch == ')') {
            while (!isEmpty(&s) && peek(&s) != '(')
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            pop(&s);  // Remove '('
        } else {
            while (!isEmpty(&s) && prec(peek(&s)) >= prec(ch))
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            push(&s, ch);
        }
    }
    while (!isEmpty(&s)) postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
    postfix[j] = '\0';
}

// 3. Postfix Evaluation
int evalPostfix(char *postfix) {
    Stack s; init(&s);
    for (int i = 0; postfix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = postfix[i];
        if (isdigit(ch)) push(&s, ch - '0');
        else {
            int b = pop(&s);
            int a = pop(&s);
            switch(ch) {
                case '+': push(&s, a + b); break;
                case '-': push(&s, a - b); break;
                case '*': push(&s, a * b); break;
                case '/': push(&s, a / b); break;
            }
        }
    }
    return pop(&s);
}

int main() {
    printf("=== Stack Applications Demo ===\n\n");

    // 1. Parentheses
    char *expr1 = "({[]})";
    char *expr2 = "({[)]}";
    printf("1. Parentheses Matching:\n");
    printf("  %s → %s\n", expr1, isBalanced(expr1) ? "BALANCED" : "NOT BALANCED");
    printf("  %s → %s\n", expr2, isBalanced(expr2) ? "BALANCED" : "NOT BALANCED");

    // 2. Infix to Postfix
    char infix[] = "A+B*C";
    char postfix[100];
    infixToPostfix(infix, postfix);
    printf("\n2. Infix to Postfix:\n");
    printf("  Infix: %s\n", infix);
    printf("  Postfix: %s\n", postfix);

    // 3. Postfix Evaluation
    char *post = "34+5*";
    int result = evalPostfix(post);
    printf("\n3. Postfix Evaluation:\n");
    printf("  Postfix: %s\n", post);
    printf("  Result: %d\n", result);

    return 0;
}

items.title: 🎯 What is a Data Structure?
items.text: Definition: A data structure is a scheme of organizing data in the memory of the computer in such a way that various operations can be performed efficiently on this data.
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: Why Do We Need Data Structures?
items.text:
1. Large amounts of data - Computers deal with text, images, relational data, etc.
  2. Data is raw material - For information, analytics, business intelligence, advertising
  3. Organization matters - The way data is organized in memory plays a key role in deciding time complexity of algorithms
  4. Data Structures & Algorithms go hand in hand - You can't have efficient algorithms without proper data structures

items.title: 🧠 Abstract Data Type (ADT)
items.text:
ADT is used to represent data and operations associated with an entity from the point of view of user irrespective of implementation.

  • ADT specifies WHAT operations are supported, not HOW they are implemented
  • Same ADT can be implemented using different data structures
  • Example: Stack ADT can be implemented using Array OR Linked List

items.title: Static Memory Allocation
items.text:
• Allocated by compiler at compile time
  • Exact size and type must be known at compile time
  • Memory allocated in stack area
  • Examples: int b; int c[10];

Disadvantages: - Size cannot be altered at runtime - May lead to under/over utilization of memory - Memory cannot be deleted explicitly - Only useful when data size is fixed and known beforehand
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: Dynamic Memory Allocation
items.text:
• Memory allocated and released during program execution
  • Operates at low level
  • Functions defined in <stdlib.h>
Function Purpose malloc(size) Allocate memory (uninitialized) calloc(n, size) Allocate memory (zero-initialized) realloc(ptr, new_size) Resize allocated memory free(ptr) Release allocated memory

items.title: malloc()
items.text:
void *malloc(size_t size);
- Takes number of bytes to allocate - Use sizeof to determine size of a type - Returns void* (can be assigned to any pointer) - Returns NULL if no memory available

Example: Allocate space for 100 integers 

int *p;
if ((p = (int*)malloc(100 * sizeof(int))) == NULL) {
    printf("out of memory\n");
    exit(1);
}
// Access as p[0], p[1], ..., p[99] or *p, *(p+1), ...
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: calloc()
items.text:
void *calloc(size_t nitem, size_t size);
- Allocates memory and initializes to zero - Requires two arguments: number of items and size of each item

Example: 

int *p = (int*)calloc(100, sizeof(int)); // 100 ints, all zeros
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: realloc()
items.text:
void *realloc(void *ptr, size_t new_size);
- Resizes previously allocated block - Two arguments: pointer to existing block, new size

Example: 

int *ip = (int*)malloc(100 * sizeof(int));
// ... later need twice as much ...
ip = (int*)realloc(ip, 200 * sizeof(int));
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: free()
items.text:
void free(void *ptr);
- Deallocates memory allocated by malloc/calloc/realloc - Takes a pointer as argument

Critical Concepts: - Dangling Pointer: Pointer to memory that has been freed - Memory Leak: Allocated memory with no pointer to it (cannot be freed)

// DANGEROUS - Dangling pointer
int *p = malloc(sizeof(int));
free(p);
// p now dangles - points to freed memory!
// *p = 10; // UNDEFINED BEHAVIOR!

// DANGEROUS - Memory leak
int *p = malloc(sizeof(int));
*p = 30;
p = malloc(sizeof(int)); // First block lost forever!

items.text: A linked list is a linear data structure where: - Elements (nodes) are NOT stored in contiguous memory - Each node contains data and a pointer (link) to the next node - Head/start pointer points to the first node - Last node's link contains NULL

items.title: Insertion Operations (3 Cases)
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: Case 1: Insert at Beginning
items.text:
void insert_front(NODE **head, int value) {
    NODE *temp = (NODE*)malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    temp->data = value;
    temp->link = NULL;

    if (*head == NULL) {
        // Empty list - new node becomes head
        *head = temp;
    } else {
        // List not empty - insert before current head
        temp->link = *head;
        *head = temp;
    }
}

Visual Walkthrough: 

Before: head → [10|•] → [20|•] → [30|NULL]

Insert 5 at front:
1. Create node with data=5, link=NULL
2. temp->link = head (points to 10)
3. head = temp (points to 5)

After:  head → [5|•] → [10|•] → [20|•] → [30|NULL]
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: Case 2: Insert at End
items.text:
void insert_end(NODE **head, int value) {
    NODE *temp = (NODE*)malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    temp->data = value;
    temp->link = NULL;

    if (*head == NULL) {
        *head = temp;
    } else {
        NODE *curr = *head;
        // Traverse to last node
        while (curr->link != NULL) {
            curr = curr->link;
        }
        // curr is now last node
        curr->link = temp;
    }
}
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: Case 3: Insert at Given Position
items.text:
void insert_at_pos(NODE **head, int value, int pos) {
    NODE *temp = (NODE*)malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    temp->data = value;
    temp->link = NULL;

    if (*head == NULL || pos == 1) {
        // Empty list or insert at front
        temp->link = *head;
        *head = temp;
        return;
    }

    NODE *curr = *head;
    NODE *prev = NULL;
    int i = 1;

    // Traverse to position
    while (curr != NULL && i < pos) {
        prev = curr;
        curr = curr->link;
        i++;
    }

    if (curr == NULL) {
        // Position beyond end - insert at end
        prev->link = temp;
    } else {
        // Insert between prev and curr
        prev->link = temp;
        temp->link = curr;
    }
}

items.title: Deletion Operations (3 Cases)
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: Case 1: Delete First Node
items.text:
void delete_front(NODE **head) {
    if (*head == NULL) {
        printf("List empty\n");
        return;
    }

    NODE *temp = *head;

    if ((*head)->link == NULL) {
        // Only one node
        *head = NULL;
    } else {
        // More than one node
        *head = (*head)->link;
    }

    free(temp);
}
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: Case 2: Delete Last Node
items.text:
void delete_end(NODE **head) {
    if (*head == NULL) {
        printf("List empty\n");
        return;
    }

    if ((*head)->link == NULL) {
        // Only one node
        free(*head);
        *head = NULL;
        return;
    }

    NODE *curr = *head;
    NODE *prev = NULL;

    // Traverse to last node, keeping track of previous
    while (curr->link != NULL) {
        prev = curr;
        curr = curr->link;
    }

    // curr is last node, prev is second-last
    prev->link = NULL;
    free(curr);
}
path: Unit 1: Introduction to Data Structures & C Fundamentals

items.title: Case 3: Delete at Given Position
items.text:
void delete_at_pos(NODE **head, int pos) {
    if (*head == NULL) {
        printf("List empty\n");
        return;
    }

    if (pos == 1) {
        // Delete first node
        NODE *temp = *head;
        *head = (*head)->link;
        free(temp);
        return;
    }

    NODE *curr = *head;
    NODE *prev = NULL;
    int i = 1;

    while (curr != NULL && i < pos) {
        prev = curr;
        curr = curr->link;
        i++;
    }

    if (curr == NULL) {
        printf("Invalid position\n");
        return;
    }

    if (curr->link == NULL) {
        // Last node
        prev->link = NULL;
    } else {
        // Middle node
        prev->link = curr->link;
    }

    free(curr);
}

void delete_node_dll(dll_t *list, NODE *temp) {
    if (temp == NULL) return;

    if (temp == list->head && temp == list->tail) {
        // Only node
        list->head = list->tail = NULL;
    } else if (temp == list->head) {
        // First node
        list->head = temp->next;
        list->head->prev = NULL;
    } else if (temp == list->tail) {
        // Last node
        list->tail = temp->prev;
        list->tail->next = NULL;
    } else {
        // Middle node
        temp->prev->next = temp->next;
        temp->next->prev = temp->prev;
    }

    free(temp);
}

items.title: Josephus Problem (Classic Application)
items.text:
Problem: n people in circle, eliminate every k-th person, find survivor.

int josephus(int n, int k) {
    // Create circular list 1..n
    node_t *head = NULL, *tail = NULL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
        temp->key = i;
        if (!head) head = tail = temp;
        else { tail->next = temp; tail = temp; }
    }
    tail->next = head;  // Make circular

    node_t *curr = head, *prev = tail;
    while (curr->next != curr) {
        // Count k-1 steps
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            prev = curr;
            curr = curr->next;
        }
        // Eliminate curr
        prev->next = curr->next;
        free(curr);
        curr = prev->next;
    }
    int survivor = curr->key;
    free(curr);
    return survivor;
}

items.title: Program 1: Complete Singly Linked List
items.text:
// sll_complete.c - Complete Singly Linked List Implementation
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef struct node {
    int data;
    struct node *next;
} NODE;

NODE *create_node(int data) {
    NODE *temp = (NODE*)malloc(sizeof(NODE));
    if (!temp) { printf("Memory full\n"); exit(1); }
    temp->data = data;
    temp->next = NULL;
    return temp;
}

void insert_front(NODE **head, int data) {
    NODE *temp = create_node(data);
    temp->next = *head;
    *head = temp;
}

void insert_end(NODE **head, int data) {
    NODE *temp = create_node(data);
    if (*head == NULL) { *head = temp; return; }
    NODE *curr = *head;
    while (curr->next) curr = curr->next;
    curr->next = temp;
}

void insert_at_pos(NODE **head, int data, int pos) {
    if (pos <= 1 || *head == NULL) { insert_front(head, data); return; }
    NODE *temp = create_node(data);
    NODE *curr = *head, *prev = NULL;
    int i = 1;
    while (curr && i < pos) { prev = curr; curr = curr->next; i++; }
    if (!curr) { prev->next = temp; }
    else { prev->next = temp; temp->next = curr; }
}

void delete_front(NODE **head) {
    if (!*head) return;
    NODE *temp = *head;
    *head = (*head)->next;
    free(temp);
}

void delete_end(NODE **head) {
    if (!*head) return;
    if (!(*head)->next) { free(*head); *head = NULL; return; }
    NODE *curr = *head, *prev = NULL;
    while (curr->next) { prev = curr; curr = curr->next; }
    prev->next = NULL;
    free(curr);
}

void delete_at_pos(NODE **head, int pos) {
    if (!*head) return;
    if (pos <= 1) { delete_front(head); return; }
    NODE *curr = *head, *prev = NULL;
    int i = 1;
    while (curr && i < pos) { prev = curr; curr = curr->next; i++; }
    if (!curr) { printf("Invalid position\n"); return; }
    prev->next = curr->next;
    free(curr);
}

void display(NODE *head) {
    printf("List: ");
    while (head) { printf("%d → ", head->data); head = head->next; }
    printf("NULL\n");
}

int main() {
    NODE *head = NULL;

    printf("=== Singly Linked List Demo ===\n");
    insert_end(&head, 10);
    insert_end(&head, 20);
    insert_end(&head, 30);
    display(head);  // 10 → 20 → 30

    insert_front(&head, 5);
    display(head);  // 5 → 10 → 20 → 30

    insert_at_pos(&head, 15, 3);
    display(head);  // 5 → 10 → 15 → 20 → 30

    delete_front(&head);
    display(head);  // 10 → 15 → 20 → 30

    delete_end(&head);
    display(head);  // 10 → 15 → 20

    delete_at_pos(&head, 2);
    display(head);  // 10 → 20

    return 0;
}

// memory_demo.c - Dynamic Memory Allocation Demo
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

int main() {
    printf("=== Dynamic Memory Demo ===\n\n");

    // 1. malloc
    printf("1. malloc():\n");
    int *p = (int*)malloc(5 * sizeof(int));
    if (!p) { printf("Failed\n"); return 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) p[i] = (i+1)*10;
    printf("Allocated 5 ints: ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) printf("%d ", p[i]);
    printf("\n");
    free(p);
    p = NULL;  // Good practice: set to NULL after free

    // 2. calloc (zero-initialized)
    printf("\n2. calloc():\n");
    int *q = (int*)calloc(5, sizeof(int));
    printf("Zero-initialized: ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) printf("%d ", q[i]);
    printf("\n");
    free(q);

    // 3. realloc
    printf("\n3. realloc():\n");
    int *r = (int*)malloc(3 * sizeof(int));
    r[0] = 1; r[1] = 2; r[2] = 3;
    printf("Before realloc: ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) printf("%d ", r[i]);
    r = (int*)realloc(r, 6 * sizeof(int));
    r[3] = 4; r[4] = 5; r[5] = 6;
    printf("\nAfter realloc:  ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) printf("%d ", r[i]);
    printf("\n");
    free(r);

    // 4. Structure allocation
    printf("\n4. Structure allocation:\n");
    struct student {
        char name[20];
        int roll;
        float marks;
    };
    struct student *s = (struct student*)malloc(sizeof(struct student));
    strcpy(s->name, "Alice");
    s->roll = 101;
    s->marks = 95.5;
    printf("Student: %s, Roll: %d, Marks: %.1f\n", s->name, s->roll, s->marks);
    free(s);

    printf("\n=== Dangling Pointer Demo ===\n");
    int *dang = (int*)malloc(sizeof(int));
    *dang = 100;
    printf("Before free: *dang = %d\n", *dang);
    free(dang);
    // dang is now DANGLING - don't use it!
    dang = NULL;  // Always set to NULL after free

    printf("\n=== Memory Leak Demo ===\n");
    // BAD: memory leak
    // int *leak = malloc(sizeof(int));
    // leak = malloc(sizeof(int));  // First block lost!

    // GOOD: free before reassign
    int *good = malloc(sizeof(int));
    *good = 42;
    free(good);
    good = malloc(sizeof(int));
    *good = 84;
    free(good);
    printf("No leaks!\n");

    return 0;
}

items.text:
// circular_josephus.c - Circular List & Josephus Problem
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef struct node {
    int key;
    struct node *next;
} node_t;

node_t* create_node(int key) {
    node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->key = key;
    temp->next = NULL;
    return temp;
}

void insert_clist(node_t **head, int key) {
    node_t *temp = create_node(key);
    if (*head == NULL) {
        temp->next = temp;
        *head = temp;
    } else {
        temp->next = (*head)->next;
        (*head)->next = temp;
    }
}

void disp_clist(node_t *head) {
    if (!head) { printf("Empty\n"); return; }
    node_t *temp = head;
    printf("Circular: ");
    do {
        printf("%d ", temp->key);
        temp = temp->next;
    } while (temp != head);
    printf("\n");
}

// Josephus Problem
int josephus(int n, int k) {
    node_t *head = NULL, *tail = NULL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
        temp->key = i; temp->next = NULL;
        if (!head) head = tail = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
        else { tail->next = temp; tail = temp; }
    }
    tail->next = head;  // Make circular

    node_t *curr = head, *prev = head;
    // Find tail (node before head)
    while (prev->next != head) prev = prev->next;

    while (curr->next != curr) {
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            prev = curr;
            curr = curr->next;
        }
        prev->next = curr->next;
        free(curr);
        curr = prev->next;
    }
    int survivor = curr->key;
    free(curr);
    return survivor;
}

int main() {
    printf("=== Circular List Demo ===\n");
    node_t *head = NULL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) insert_clist(&head, i*10);
    printf("List: "); disp_clist(head);

    printf("\n=== Josephus Problem ===\n");
    printf("n=7, k=3: Survivor = %d\n", josephus(7, 3));  // 4
    printf("n=5, k=2: Survivor = %d\n", josephus(5, 2));  // 3
    printf("n=41, k=3: Survivor = %d\n", josephus(41, 3)); // Historical: 31

    return 0;
}

items.title: What is a Stack?
items.text: Stack is a linear data structure that follows LIFO (Last In First Out) principle. - Insertion: Push (at top) - Deletion: Pop (from top) - View top: Peek/Top

items.title: Real-World Analogy
items.text:
• Stack of plates in a cafeteria
  • Stack of books on a desk
  • Browser back button (history stack)
  • Function call stack (recursion)

items.title: Stack ADT Interface
items.text:
void init_stack(stack_t *s);      // Initialize empty stack
void deinit_stack(stack_t *s);    // Clean up
void push(stack_t *s, int val);   // Insert at top
int pop(stack_t *s);              // Remove from top
int peek(stack_t *s);             // View top without removing
int is_empty(stack_t *s);         // Check if empty
int is_full(stack_t *s);          // Check if full (bounded)

items.title: Structure
items.text:
#define MAXSIZE 5

struct stack {
    int data[MAXSIZE];
    int top;        // Index of top element (-1 = empty)
};
typedef struct stack stack_t;

items.title: Initialize
items.text:
void init_stack(stack_t *s) {
    s->top = -1;  // -1 means empty
}

items.title: Push
items.text:
void push(stack_t *s, int val) {
    if (is_full(s)) {
        printf("Stack overflow\n");
        return;
    }
    s->data[++s->top] = val;  // Increment first, then store
}

items.title: Pop
items.text:
int pop(stack_t *s) {
    if (is_empty(s)) {
        printf("Stack underflow\n");
        return -1;
    }
    return s->data[s->top--];  // Return value, then decrement
}

items.title: Peek
items.text:
int peek(stack_t *s) {
    if (is_empty(s)) return -1;
    return s->data[s->top];
}

items.title: Empty/Full Check
items.text:
int is_empty(stack_t *s) { return s->top == -1; }
int is_full(stack_t *s) { return s->top == MAXSIZE - 1; }

items.title: 📝 Key Takeaways
items.text: Concept Key Point Stack LIFO, Push/Pop at top Array Stack Fixed size, O(1) operations top = -1 Empty indicator top = MAXSIZE-1 Full indicator ++top Pre-increment for push top-- Post-decrement for pop

    node_t *top;

items.title: Operations
items.text:
void init_stack(stack_t *s) { s->top = NULL; }

void push(stack_t *s, int val) {
    node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->data = val;
    temp->next = s->top;
    s->top = temp;
}

int pop(stack_t *s) {
    if (!s->top) return -1;
    int val = s->top->data;
    node_t *temp = s->top;
    s->top = s->top->next;
    free(temp);
    return val;
}

int is_empty(stack_t *s) { return s->top == NULL; }
int is_full(stack_t *s) {
    node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    if (!temp) return 1;
    free(temp);
    return 0;
}

items.text:
Concept Key Point Linked Stack Dynamic size, no fixed limit Node Data + next pointer Top pointer Points to most recent node malloc Every push needs new node free Every pop frees node

items.title: Application 1: Parentheses Matching
items.text:
Problem: Check if parentheses in expression are balanced.

Algorithm: 

For each character in string:
    If '(', '[', '{' → push to stack
    If ')', ']', '}' → 
        If stack empty → NOT balanced
        Pop and check if matching pair
After loop: if stack empty → balanced, else NOT balanced

Matching Pairs: - ( matches ) - [ matches ] - { matches }

int is_balanced(char *expr) {
    stack_t s; init_stack(&s);

    for (int i = 0; expr[i]; i++) {
        char ch = expr[i];
        if (ch == '(' || ch == '[' || ch == '{')
            push(&s, ch);
        else if (ch == ')' || ch == ']' || ch == '}') {
            if (is_empty(&s)) return 0;
            char top = pop(&s);
            if ((ch == ')' && top != '(') ||
                (ch == ']' && top != '[') ||
                (ch == '}' && top != '{'))
                return 0;
        }
    }
    return is_empty(&s);
}

Example Traces: 

Input: "({[]})"     → BALANCED
Stack: ( → { → [ → pop[ matches ] → pop{ matches } → pop( matches ) → empty ✓

Input: "({[)]}"     → NOT BALANCED
Stack: ( → { → [ → pop[ but got ) → MISMATCH ✗

items.title: Application 2: Infix to Postfix Conversion
items.text:
Definitions: - Infix: Operator between operands (A + B) - Postfix: Operator after operands (A B +) - Prefix: Operator before operands (+ A B)

Why Postfix? No parentheses needed, easy to evaluate with stack!

Precedence Table: | Operator | Precedence | |----------|------------| | ^ | 3 (highest)| | * / % | 2 | | + - | 1 |

Algorithm (Shunting Yard): 

For each token in infix:
    If operand → output
    If '(' → push to stack
    If ')' → pop and output until '('
    If operator:
        While stack not empty AND 
              precedence(top) >= precedence(current) AND top != '(':
            pop and output
        push current operator
After loop: pop remaining operators to output


int precedence(char op) {
    if (op == '^') return 3;
    if (op == '*' || op == '/' || op == '%') return 2;
    if (op == '+' || op == '-') return 1;
    return 0;
}

void infix_to_postfix(char *infix, char *postfix) {
    stack_t s; init_stack(&s);
    int j = 0;

    for (int i = 0; infix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = infix[i];

        if (isalnum(ch)) {
            postfix[j++] = ch;  // Operand goes to output
        } else if (ch == '(') {
            push(&s, ch);
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            while (!is_empty(&s) && peek(&s) != '(')
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            pop(&s);  // Remove '('
        } else {  // Operator
            while (!is_empty(&s) && precedence(peek(&s)) >= precedence(ch))
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            push(&s, ch);
        }
    }
    while (!is_empty(&s)) postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
    postfix[j] = '\0';
}

Trace Example: 

Infix:  A + B * C
Step 1: A          → output: A
Step 2: +          → push +
Step 3: B          → output: AB
Step 4: *          → push * (higher precedence than +)
Step 5: C          → output: ABC
End:   pop * → output: ABC*  pop + → output: ABC*+

Postfix: ABC*+

items.title: Application 3: Postfix Expression Evaluation
items.text:
Algorithm: 

For each token in postfix:
    If operand → push to stack
    If operator:
        pop operand2 (right)
        pop operand1 (left)
        result = operand1 operator operand2
        push result
Final result = pop stack


int evaluate_postfix(char *postfix) {
    stack_t s; init_stack(&s);

    for (int i = 0; postfix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = postfix[i];
        if (isdigit(ch)) {
            push(&s, ch - '0');  // Convert char to int
        } else {
            int b = pop(&s);  // Right operand
            int a = pop(&s);  // Left operand
            int result;
            switch(ch) {
                case '+': result = a + b; break;
                case '-': result = a - b; break;
                case '*': result = a * b; break;
                case '/': result = a / b; break;
            }
            push(&s, result);
        }
    }
    return pop(&s);
}

Trace Example: 

Postfix:  3 4 + 5 *
Step 1: 3 → push 3      Stack: [3]
Step 2: 4 → push 4      Stack: [3, 4]
Step 3: + → pop 4, pop 3 → 3+4=7 → push 7   Stack: [7]
Step 4: 5 → push 5      Stack: [7, 5]
Step 5: * → pop 5, pop 7 → 7*5=35 → push 35  Stack: [35]
Result: 35

items.title: What is a Queue?
items.text: Queue is a linear data structure following FIFO (First In First Out). - Insert at rear (enqueue) - Remove from front (dequeue)

items.title: Real-World Examples
items.text:
• Printer queue
  • CPU process scheduling
  • Ticket counter line
  • Breadth-First Search (BFS)

items.title: Structure
items.text:
struct node {
    int data;
    struct node *next;
};
typedef struct node node_t;

struct queue {
    node_t *front;  // First element
    node_t *rear;   // Last element
};
typedef struct queue queue_t;

items.title: Enqueue (Insert at Rear)
items.text:
void enqueue(queue_t *q, int val) {
    node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->data = val;
    temp->next = NULL;

    if (q->rear == NULL) {
        // Empty queue - new node is both front and rear
        q->front = q->rear = temp;
    } else {
        q->rear->next = temp;
        q->rear = temp;
    }
}

items.title: Dequeue (Remove from Front)
items.text:
int dequeue(queue_t *q) {
    if (q->front == NULL) return -1;  // Empty

    node_t *temp = q->front;
    int val = temp->data;

    q->front = temp->next;
    if (q->front == NULL)  // Was last element
        q->rear = NULL;

    free(temp);
    return val;
}

items.title: 📝 Key Takeaways
items.text:
Concept Key Point Queue FIFO, Enqueue at rear, Dequeue at front Linked Queue Dynamic size, no fixed limit Front & Rear Two pointers for O(1) operations Empty front == NULL Single Node Front and rear point to same node

items.title: Why Circular Array?
items.text:
• Array is fixed size
  • Simple indices: front=0, rear=0 initially
  • Use modulo arithmetic to wrap around
  • Waste ONE slot to distinguish full vs empty

items.title: Structure
items.text:
#define MAXSIZE 5

struct queue {
    int data[MAXSIZE];
    int front;  // Index of front element
    int rear;   // Index of rear element
};
typedef struct queue queue_t;

items.title: Key Concept: Modulo Arithmetic
items.text:
Index = (Index + 1) % MAXSIZE

Visual: 

Array size 5: [ ][ ][ ][ ][ ]
                ↑
              front=rear=0 (empty)

Enqueue 10:  rear = (0+1)%5 = 1, data[1]=10
    [ ][10][ ][ ][ ]
           ↑   ↑
          f=0  r=1

Enqueue 20:  rear = (1+1)%5 = 2, data[2]=20
    [ ][10][20][ ][ ]
           ↑     ↑
          f=0   r=2

... continue until r=4:
    [ ][10][20][30][40]
     ↑               ↑
    f=0             r=4

Attempt to enqueue 50:
    (rear + 1) % 5 = (4 + 1) % 5 = 0 == front (f=0)
    Queue is FULL! 50 cannot be inserted (slot 0 is preserved as the empty slot).

items.title: Operations
items.text:
void init_queue(queue_t *q) {
    q->front = q->rear = 0;
}

int is_empty(queue_t *q) {
    return q->front == q->rear;
}

int is_full(queue_t *q) {
    return (q->rear + 1) % MAXSIZE == q->front;
}

void enqueue(queue_t *q, int val) {
    if (is_full(q)) { printf("Queue full\n"); return; }
    q->rear = (q->rear + 1) % MAXSIZE;
    q->data[q->rear] = val;
}

int dequeue(queue_t *q) {
    if (is_empty(q)) return -1;
    q->front = (q->front + 1) % MAXSIZE;
    return q->data[q->front];
}

items.title: Key Concept: Same Condition for Empty/Full
items.text:
• Empty: front == rear (before any operation)
  • Full: front == rear (after rear increment in enqueue)
  • We waste one slot to distinguish them

items.title: 📝 Key Takeaways
items.text:
Concept Key Point Circular Queue Modulo arithmetic, wrap around Waste 1 Slot Distinguish full vs empty front==rear Empty before op, Full after rear++ Modulo (index + 1) % MAXSIZE

items.title: What is a Priority Queue?
items.text: Priority Queue is a queue where each element has a priority. - Dequeue removes highest priority element (not FIFO) - Higher numeric value = higher priority (typically)

items.title: Real-World Examples
items.text:
• Hospital ER: Critical patients first
  • CPU scheduling: Real-time processes first
  • Network packets: QoS priority
  • Dijkstra's algorithm

items.title: Priority Queue ADT
items.text:
struct job {
    int job_no;
    int priority;
};
typedef struct job job_t;

void init_pq(pqueue_t *q);
void enqueue(pqueue_t *q, job_t *job);

items.title: Implementation 1: Unordered Linked List
items.text:
Enqueue: O(1) - Add at rear Dequeue: O(n) - Traverse to find max priority

job_t dequeue(pqueue_t *q) {
    // Find max priority node
    node_t *max_prev = NULL, *max_curr = q->front;
    node_t *prev = NULL, *curr = q->front;
    int max_pri = curr->job.priority;

    while (curr) {
        if (curr->job.priority > max_pri) {
            max_pri = curr->job.priority;
            max_prev = prev;
            max_curr = curr;
        }
        prev = curr;
        curr = curr->next;
    }

    // Remove max_curr
    job_t job = max_curr->job;
    if (max_prev == NULL)  // Was first node
        q->front = max_curr->next;
    else
        max_prev->next = max_curr->next;

    free(max_curr);
    return job;
}

items.title: Implementation 2: Ordered Linked List
items.text:
Enqueue: O(n) - Find correct position by priority Dequeue: O(1) - Remove from front

void enqueue(pqueue_t *q, job_t *job) {
    node_t *temp = create_node(job);

    // Insert in descending priority order
    if (!q->front || q->front->job.priority <= job->priority) {
        // Insert at front
        temp->next = q->front;
        q->front = temp;
        if (!q->rear) q->rear = temp;
    } else {
        // Find position
        node_t *curr = q->front;
        while (curr->next && curr->next->job.priority > job->priority)
            curr = curr->next;
        temp->next = curr->next;
        curr->next = temp;
        if (!temp->next) q->rear = temp;
    }
}

job_t dequeue(pqueue_t *q) {
    job_t job = q->front->job;
    node_t *temp = q->front;
    q->front = temp->next;
    if (!q->front) q->rear = NULL;
    free(temp);
    return job;
}

items.text:
#define MAXSIZE 100

struct pqueue {
    job_t jobs[MAXSIZE];
    int count;
};

void enqueue(pqueue_t *q, job_t *job) {
    if (q->count < MAXSIZE)
        q->jobs[q->count++] = *job;
}

job_t dequeue(pqueue_t *q) {
    int max_idx = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < q->count; i++)
        if (q->jobs[i].priority > q->jobs[max_idx].priority)
            max_idx = i;

    job_t job = q->jobs[max_idx];
    // Shift left
    for (int i = max_idx; i < q->count - 1; i++)
        q->jobs[i] = q->jobs[i + 1];
    q->count--;
    return job;
}

void enqueue(pqueue_t *q, job_t *job) {
    int i = q->count - 1;
    while (i >= 0 && q->jobs[i].priority >= job->priority) {
        q->jobs[i + 1] = q->jobs[i];
        i--;
    }
    q->jobs[i + 1] = *job;
    q->count++;
}

job_t dequeue(pqueue_t *q) {
    return q->jobs[--q->count];  // Last element = highest priority
}

// stack_apps_demo.c - All Stack Applications
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <ctype.h>

#define MAXSIZE 100

typedef struct {
    int data[MAXSIZE];
    int top;
} Stack;

void init(Stack *s) { s->top = -1; }
int isEmpty(Stack *s) { return s->top == -1; }
int isFull(Stack *s) { return s->top == MAXSIZE - 1; }

void push(Stack *s, int val) {
    if (isFull(s)) return;
    s->data[++s->top] = val;
}

int pop(Stack *s) {
    if (isEmpty(s)) return -1;
    return s->data[s->top--];
}

int peek(Stack *s) {
    if (isEmpty(s)) return -1;
    return s->data[s->top];
}

// 1. Parentheses Matching
int isBalanced(char *expr) {
    Stack s; init(&s);
    for (int i = 0; expr[i]; i++) {
        char ch = expr[i];
        if (ch == '(' || ch == '[' || ch == '{') push(&s, ch);
        else if (ch == ')' || ch == ']' || ch == '}') {
            if (isEmpty(&s)) return 0;
            char top = pop(&s);
            if ((ch == ')' && top != '(') ||
                (ch == ']' && top != '[') ||
                (ch == '}' && top != '{')) return 0;
        }
    }
    return isEmpty(&s);
}

// 2. Infix to Postfix
int prec(char op) {
    if (op == '^') return 3;
    if (op == '*' || op == '/' || op == '%') return 2;
    if (op == '+' || op == '-') return 1;
    return 0;
}

void infixToPostfix(char *infix, char *postfix) {
    Stack s; init(&s);
    int j = 0;
    for (int i = 0; infix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = infix[i];
        if (isalnum(ch)) postfix[j++] = ch;
        else if (ch == '(') push(&s, ch);
        else if (ch == ')') {
            while (!isEmpty(&s) && peek(&s) != '(')
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            pop(&s);  // Remove '('
        } else {
            while (!isEmpty(&s) && prec(peek(&s)) >= prec(ch))
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            push(&s, ch);
        }
    }
    while (!isEmpty(&s)) postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
    postfix[j] = '\0';
}

// 3. Postfix Evaluation
int evalPostfix(char *postfix) {
    Stack s; init(&s);
    for (int i = 0; postfix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = postfix[i];
        if (isdigit(ch)) push(&s, ch - '0');
        else {
            int b = pop(&s);
            int a = pop(&s);
            switch(ch) {
                case '+': push(&s, a + b); break;
                case '-': push(&s, a - b); break;
                case '*': push(&s, a * b); break;
                case '/': push(&s, a / b); break;
            }
        }
    }
    return pop(&s);
}

int main() {
    printf("=== Stack Applications Demo ===\n\n");

    // 1. Parentheses
    char *expr1 = "({[]})";
    char *expr2 = "({[)]}";
    printf("1. Parentheses Matching:\n");
    printf("  %s → %s\n", expr1, isBalanced(expr1) ? "BALANCED" : "NOT BALANCED");
    printf("  %s → %s\n", expr2, isBalanced(expr2) ? "BALANCED" : "NOT BALANCED");

    // 2. Infix to Postfix
    char infix[] = "A+B*C";
    char postfix[100];
    infixToPostfix(infix, postfix);
    printf("\n2. Infix to Postfix:\n");
    printf("  Infix: %s\n", infix);
    printf("  Postfix: %s\n", postfix);

    // 3. Postfix Evaluation
    char *post = "34+5*";
    int result = evalPostfix(post);
    printf("\n3. Postfix Evaluation:\n");
    printf("  Postfix: %s\n", post);
    printf("  Result: %d\n", result);

    return 0;
}

// queue_demo.c - All Queue Implementations
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define MAXSIZE 5

// ===== 1. Linked List Queue =====
typedef struct node {
    int data;
    struct node *next;
} Node;

typedef struct {
    Node *front, *rear;
} LLQueue;

void ll_init(LLQueue *q) { q->front = q->rear = NULL; }

void ll_enqueue(LLQueue *q, int val) {
    Node *temp = (Node*)malloc(sizeof(Node));
    temp->data = val; temp->next = NULL;
    if (!q->rear) q->front = q->rear = temp;
    else { q->rear->next = temp; q->rear = temp; }
}

int ll_dequeue(LLQueue *q) {
    if (!q->front) return -1;
    Node *temp = q->front;
    int val = temp->data;
    q->front = temp->next;
    if (!q->front) q->rear = NULL;
    free(temp);
    return val;
}

// ===== 2. Circular Array Queue =====
typedef struct {
    int data[MAXSIZE];
    int front, rear;
} CAQueue;

void ca_init(CAQueue *q) { q->front = q->rear = 0; }
int ca_empty(CAQueue *q) { return q->front == q->rear; }
int ca_full(CAQueue *q) { return (q->rear + 1) % MAXSIZE == q->front; }

void ca_enqueue(CAQueue *q, int val) {
    if (ca_full(q)) { printf("Full\n"); return; }
    q->rear = (q->rear + 1) % MAXSIZE;
    q->data[q->rear] = val;
}

int ca_dequeue(CAQueue *q) {
    if (ca_empty(q)) return -1;
    q->front = (q->front + 1) % MAXSIZE;
    return q->data[q->front];
}

int main() {
    printf("=== Queue Implementations Demo ===\n\n");

    // Linked List Queue
    printf("1. Linked List Queue:\n");
    LLQueue llq; ll_init(&llq);
    ll_enqueue(&llq, 10); ll_enqueue(&llq, 20); ll_enqueue(&llq, 30);
    printf("Dequeue: %d\n", ll_dequeue(&llq));  // 10
    ll_enqueue(&llq, 40);
    while (!ca_empty((CAQueue*)&llq))  // Hack: reuse empty check
        printf("Dequeue: %d\n", ll_dequeue(&llq));

    // Circular Array Queue
    printf("\n2. Circular Array Queue (size 5):\n");
    CAQueue caq; ca_init(&caq);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 4; i++) ca_enqueue(&caq, i*10);
    printf("Enqueued 10,20,30,40\n");
    ca_enqueue(&caq, 50);  // Fills last slot
    ca_enqueue(&caq, 60);  // Should say "Full"
    printf("Dequeue all: ");
    while (!ca_empty(&caq))
        printf("%d ", ca_dequeue(&caq));
    printf("\n");

    return 0;
}

items.text:
// pq_comparison.c - Priority Queue All 4 Implementations
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define MAXSIZE 100

typedef struct { int job_no, priority; } Job;

typedef struct node { Job job; struct node *next; } Node;
typedef struct { Node *front, *rear; } PQList;

// Helper
Node* create_node(Job j) {
    Node *n = (Node*)malloc(sizeof(Node));
    n->job = j; n->next = NULL;
    return n;
}

// ===== 1. Unordered List =====
void ulist_init(PQList *q) { q->front = q->rear = NULL; }

void ulist_enqueue(PQList *q, Job j) {
    Node *n = create_node(j);
    if (!q->rear) q->front = q->rear = n;
    else { q->rear->next = n; q->rear = n; }
}

Job ulist_dequeue(PQList *q) {
    Node *max_p = NULL, *max_c = q->front, *p = NULL, *c = q->front;
    int max_pri = c->job.priority;
    while (c) {
        if (c->job.priority > max_pri) {
            max_pri = c->job.priority; max_p = p; max_c = c;
        }
        p = c; c = c->next;
    }
    Job job = max_c->job;
    if (!max_p) q->front = max_c->next;
    else max_p->next = max_c->next;
    if (!max_c->next) q->rear = max_p;
    free(max_c);
    return job;
}

// ===== 2. Ordered List =====
void olist_enqueue(PQList *q, Job j) {
    Node *n = create_node(j);
    if (!q->front || q->front->job.priority <= j.priority) {
        n->next = q->front; q->front = n;
        if (!q->rear) q->rear = n;
    } else {
        Node *c = q->front;
        while (c->next && c->next->job.priority > j.priority) c = c->next;
        n->next = c->next; c->next = n;
        if (!n->next) q->rear = n;
    }
}

Job olist_dequeue(PQList *q) {
    Job j = q->front->job;
    Node *t = q->front;
    q->front = t->next;
    if (!q->front) q->rear = NULL;
    free(t);
    return j;
}

// ===== 3. Unordered Array =====
typedef struct { Job jobs[MAXSIZE]; int n; } PQArray;

void uarr_init(PQArray *q) { q->n = 0; }
void uarr_enqueue(PQArray *q, Job j) {
    if (q->n < MAXSIZE) q->jobs[q->n++] = j;
}

Job uarr_dequeue(PQArray *q) {
    int max_i = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < q->n; i++)
        if (q->jobs[i].priority > q->jobs[max_i].priority) max_i = i;
    Job j = q->jobs[max_i];
    for (int i = max_i; i < q->n - 1; i++) q->jobs[i] = q->jobs[i+1];
    q->n--;
    return j;
}

// ===== 4. Ordered Array =====
void oarr_enqueue(PQArray *q, Job j) {
    int i = q->n - 1;
    while (i >= 0 && q->jobs[i].priority >= j.priority) {
        q->jobs[i+1] = q->jobs[i];
        i--;
    }
    q->jobs[i+1] = j; q->n++;
}

Job oarr_dequeue(PQArray *q) {
    return q->jobs[--q->n];
}

int main() {
    printf("=== Priority Queue Comparison ===\n\n");

    // Unordered List
    PQList ulist; ulist_init(&ulist);
    Job jobs[] = {{1,10}, {2,30}, {3,20}, {4,5}, {5,25}};
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) ulist_enqueue(&ulist, jobs[i]);
    printf("Unordered List (Dequeue order): ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        Job j = ulist_dequeue(&ulist);
        printf("J%d(p%d) ", j.job_no, j.priority);
    }
    printf("\n");

    // Ordered List
    PQList olist; ulist_init(&olist);
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) olist_enqueue(&olist, jobs[i]);
    printf("Ordered List (Dequeue order):  ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        Job j = olist_dequeue(&olist);
        printf("J%d(p%d) ", j.job_no, j.priority);
    }
    printf("\n");

    // Unordered Array
    PQArray uarr; uarr_init(&uarr);
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) uarr_enqueue(&uarr, jobs[i]);
    printf("Unordered Array (Dequeue):       ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        Job j = uarr_dequeue(&uarr);
        printf("J%d(p%d) ", j.job_no, j.priority);
    }
    printf("\n");

    // Ordered Array
    PQArray oarr; uarr_init(&oarr);
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) oarr_enqueue(&oarr, jobs[i]);
    printf("Ordered Array (Dequeue):         ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        Job j = oarr_dequeue(&oarr);
        printf("J%d(p%d) ", j.job_no, j.priority);
    }
    printf("\n");

    return 0;
}

items.title: Application 1: Parentheses Matching
items.text:
Problem: Check if parentheses in expression are balanced.

Algorithm: 

For each character in string:
    If '(', '[', '{' → push to stack
    If ')', ']', '}' → 
        If stack empty → NOT balanced
        Pop and check if matching pair
After loop: if stack empty → balanced, else NOT balanced

Matching Pairs: - ( matches ) - [ matches ] - { matches }

int is_balanced(char *expr) {
    stack_t s; init_stack(&s);

    for (int i = 0; expr[i]; i++) {
        char ch = expr[i];
        if (ch == '(' || ch == '[' || ch == '{')
            push(&s, ch);
        else if (ch == ')' || ch == ']' || ch == '}') {
            if (is_empty(&s)) return 0;
            char top = pop(&s);
            if ((ch == ')' && top != '(') ||
                (ch == ']' && top != '[') ||
                (ch == '}' && top != '{'))
                return 0;
        }
    }
    return is_empty(&s);
}

Example Traces: 

Input: "({[]})"     → BALANCED
Stack: ( → { → [ → pop[ matches ] → pop{ matches } → pop( matches ) → empty ✓

Input: "({[)]}"     → NOT BALANCED
Stack: ( → { → [ → pop[ but got ) → MISMATCH ✗

items.title: Application 2: Infix to Postfix Conversion
items.text:
Definitions: - Infix: Operator between operands (A + B) - Postfix: Operator after operands (A B +) - Prefix: Operator before operands (+ A B)

Why Postfix? No parentheses needed, easy to evaluate with stack!

Precedence Table: | Operator | Precedence | |----------|------------| | ^ | 3 (highest)| | * / % | 2 | | + - | 1 |

Algorithm (Shunting Yard): 

For each token in infix:
    If operand → output
    If '(' → push to stack
    If ')' → pop and output until '('
    If operator:
        While stack not empty AND 
              precedence(top) >= precedence(current) AND top != '(':
            pop and output
        push current operator
After loop: pop remaining operators to output


int precedence(char op) {
    if (op == '^') return 3;
    if (op == '*' || op == '/' || op == '%') return 2;
    if (op == '+' || op == '-') return 1;
    return 0;
}

void infix_to_postfix(char *infix, char *postfix) {
    stack_t s; init_stack(&s);
    int j = 0;

    for (int i = 0; infix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = infix[i];

        if (isalnum(ch)) {
            postfix[j++] = ch;  // Operand goes to output
        } else if (ch == '(') {
            push(&s, ch);
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            while (!is_empty(&s) && peek(&s) != '(')
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            pop(&s);  // Remove '('
        } else {  // Operator
            while (!is_empty(&s) && precedence(peek(&s)) >= precedence(ch))
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            push(&s, ch);
        }
    }
    while (!is_empty(&s)) postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
    postfix[j] = '\0';
}

Trace Example: 

Infix:  A + B * C
Step 1: A          → output: A
Step 2: +          → push +
Step 3: B          → output: AB
Step 4: *          → push * (higher precedence than +)
Step 5: C          → output: ABC
End:   pop * → output: ABC*  pop + → output: ABC*+

Postfix: ABC*+

items.title: Application 3: Postfix Expression Evaluation
items.text:
Algorithm: 

For each token in postfix:
    If operand → push to stack
    If operator:
        pop operand2 (right)
        pop operand1 (left)
        result = operand1 operator operand2
        push result
Final result = pop stack


int evaluate_postfix(char *postfix) {
    stack_t s; init_stack(&s);

    for (int i = 0; postfix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = postfix[i];
        if (isdigit(ch)) {
            push(&s, ch - '0');  // Convert char to int
        } else {
            int b = pop(&s);  // Right operand
            int a = pop(&s);  // Left operand
            int result;
            switch(ch) {
                case '+': result = a + b; break;
                case '-': result = a - b; break;
                case '*': result = a * b; break;
                case '/': result = a / b; break;
            }
            push(&s, result);
        }
    }
    return pop(&s);
}

Trace Example: 

Postfix:  3 4 + 5 *
Step 1: 3 → push 3      Stack: [3]
Step 2: 4 → push 4      Stack: [3, 4]
Step 3: + → pop 4, pop 3 → 3+4=7 → push 7   Stack: [7]
Step 4: 5 → push 5      Stack: [7, 5]
Step 5: * → pop 5, pop 7 → 7*5=35 → push 35  Stack: [35]
Result: 35

void enqueue(queue_t *q, int val) {
    node_t *temp = (node_t*)malloc(sizeof(node_t));
    temp->data = val;
    temp->next = NULL;

    if (q->rear == NULL) {
        // Empty queue - new node is both front and rear

    } else {
        q->rear->next = temp;
        q->rear = temp;
    }
}

items.text:
int dequeue(queue_t *q) {
    if (q->front == NULL) return -1;  // Empty

    node_t *temp = q->front;
    int val = temp->data;

    q->front = temp->next;
    if (q->front == NULL)  // Was last element
        q->rear = NULL;

    free(temp);
    return val;
}

Visual: 

Array size 5: [ ][ ][ ][ ][ ]

items.title: Implementation 1: Unordered Linked List
items.text:
Enqueue: O(1) - Add at rear Dequeue: O(n) - Traverse to find max priority

job_t dequeue(pqueue_t *q) {
    // Find max priority node
    node_t *max_prev = NULL, *max_curr = q->front;
    node_t *prev = NULL, *curr = q->front;
    int max_pri = curr->job.priority;

    while (curr) {
        if (curr->job.priority > max_pri) {
            max_pri = curr->job.priority;
            max_prev = prev;
            max_curr = curr;
        }
        prev = curr;
        curr = curr->next;
    }

    // Remove max_curr
    job_t job = max_curr->job;
    if (max_prev == NULL)  // Was first node
        q->front = max_curr->next;
    else
        max_prev->next = max_curr->next;

    free(max_curr);
    return job;
}

items.title: Implementation 2: Ordered Linked List
items.text:
Enqueue: O(n) - Find correct position by priority Dequeue: O(1) - Remove from front

void enqueue(pqueue_t *q, job_t *job) {
    node_t *temp = create_node(job);

    // Insert in descending priority order
    if (!q->front || q->front->job.priority <= job->priority) {
        // Insert at front
        temp->next = q->front;
        q->front = temp;
        if (!q->rear) q->rear = temp;
    } else {
        // Find position
        node_t *curr = q->front;
        while (curr->next && curr->next->job.priority > job->priority)
            curr = curr->next;
        temp->next = curr->next;
        curr->next = temp;
        if (!temp->next) q->rear = temp;
    }
}

job_t dequeue(pqueue_t *q) {
    job_t job = q->front->job;
    node_t *temp = q->front;
    q->front = temp->next;
    if (!q->front) q->rear = NULL;
    free(temp);
    return job;
}

#define MAXSIZE 100

struct pqueue {
    job_t jobs[MAXSIZE];
    int count;
};

void enqueue(pqueue_t *q, job_t *job) {
    if (q->count < MAXSIZE)
        q->jobs[q->count++] = *job;
}

job_t dequeue(pqueue_t *q) {
    int max_idx = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < q->count; i++)
        if (q->jobs[i].priority > q->jobs[max_idx].priority)
            max_idx = i;

    job_t job = q->jobs[max_idx];
    // Shift left
    for (int i = max_idx; i < q->count - 1; i++)
        q->jobs[i] = q->jobs[i + 1];
    q->count--;
    return job;
}

items.title: Implementation 4: Ordered Array

void enqueue(pqueue_t *q, job_t *job) {
    int i = q->count - 1;
    while (i >= 0 && q->jobs[i].priority >= job->priority) {
        q->jobs[i + 1] = q->jobs[i];
        i--;
    }
    q->jobs[i + 1] = *job;
    q->count++;
}

job_t dequeue(pqueue_t *q) {
    return q->jobs[--q->count];  // Last element = highest priority
}

// stack_apps_demo.c - All Stack Applications
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <ctype.h>

#define MAXSIZE 100

typedef struct {
    int data[MAXSIZE];
    int top;
} Stack;

void init(Stack *s) { s->top = -1; }
int isEmpty(Stack *s) { return s->top == -1; }
int isFull(Stack *s) { return s->top == MAXSIZE - 1; }

void push(Stack *s, int val) {
    if (isFull(s)) return;
    s->data[++s->top] = val;
}

int pop(Stack *s) {
    if (isEmpty(s)) return -1;
    return s->data[s->top--];
}

int peek(Stack *s) {
    if (isEmpty(s)) return -1;
    return s->data[s->top];
}

// 1. Parentheses Matching
int isBalanced(char *expr) {
    Stack s; init(&s);
    for (int i = 0; expr[i]; i++) {
        char ch = expr[i];
        if (ch == '(' || ch == '[' || ch == '{') push(&s, ch);
        else if (ch == ')' || ch == ']' || ch == '}') {
            if (isEmpty(&s)) return 0;
            char top = pop(&s);
            if ((ch == ')' && top != '(') ||
                (ch == ']' && top != '[') ||
                (ch == '}' && top != '{')) return 0;
        }
    }
    return isEmpty(&s);
}

// 2. Infix to Postfix
int prec(char op) {
    if (op == '^') return 3;
    if (op == '*' || op == '/' || op == '%') return 2;
    if (op == '+' || op == '-') return 1;
    return 0;
}

void infixToPostfix(char *infix, char *postfix) {
    Stack s; init(&s);
    int j = 0;
    for (int i = 0; infix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = infix[i];
        if (isalnum(ch)) postfix[j++] = ch;
        else if (ch == '(') push(&s, ch);
        else if (ch == ')') {
            while (!isEmpty(&s) && peek(&s) != '(')
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            pop(&s);  // Remove '('
        } else {
            while (!isEmpty(&s) && prec(peek(&s)) >= prec(ch))
                postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
            push(&s, ch);
        }
    }
    while (!isEmpty(&s)) postfix[j++] = pop(&s);
    postfix[j] = '\0';
}

// 3. Postfix Evaluation
int evalPostfix(char *postfix) {
    Stack s; init(&s);
    for (int i = 0; postfix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = postfix[i];
        if (isdigit(ch)) push(&s, ch - '0');
        else {
            int b = pop(&s);
            int a = pop(&s);
            switch(ch) {
                case '+': push(&s, a + b); break;
                case '-': push(&s, a - b); break;
                case '*': push(&s, a * b); break;
                case '/': push(&s, a / b); break;
            }
        }
    }
    return pop(&s);
}

int main() {
    printf("=== Stack Applications Demo ===\n\n");

    // 1. Parentheses
    char *expr1 = "({[]})";
    char *expr2 = "({[)]}";
    printf("1. Parentheses Matching:\n");
    printf("  %s → %s\n", expr1, isBalanced(expr1) ? "BALANCED" : "NOT BALANCED");
    printf("  %s → %s\n", expr2, isBalanced(expr2) ? "BALANCED" : "NOT BALANCED");

    // 2. Infix to Postfix
    char infix[] = "A+B*C";
    char postfix[100];
    infixToPostfix(infix, postfix);
    printf("\n2. Infix to Postfix:\n");
    printf("  Infix: %s\n", infix);
    printf("  Postfix: %s\n", postfix);

    // 3. Postfix Evaluation
    char *post = "34+5*";
    int result = evalPostfix(post);
    printf("\n3. Postfix Evaluation:\n");
    printf("  Postfix: %s\n", post);
    printf("  Result: %d\n", result);

    return 0;
}

// queue_demo.c - All Queue Implementations
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define MAXSIZE 5

// ===== 1. Linked List Queue =====
typedef struct node {
    int data;
    struct node *next;
} Node;

typedef struct {
    Node *front, *rear;
} LLQueue;

void ll_init(LLQueue *q) { q->front = q->rear = NULL; }

void ll_enqueue(LLQueue *q, int val) {
    Node *temp = (Node*)malloc(sizeof(Node));
    temp->data = val; temp->next = NULL;
    if (!q->rear) q->front = q->rear = temp;
    else { q->rear->next = temp; q->rear = temp; }
}

int ll_dequeue(LLQueue *q) {
    if (!q->front) return -1;
    Node *temp = q->front;
    int val = temp->data;
    q->front = temp->next;
    if (!q->front) q->rear = NULL;
    free(temp);
    return val;
}

// ===== 2. Circular Array Queue =====
typedef struct {
    int data[MAXSIZE];
    int front, rear;
} CAQueue;

void ca_init(CAQueue *q) { q->front = q->rear = 0; }
int ca_empty(CAQueue *q) { return q->front == q->rear; }
int ca_full(CAQueue *q) { return (q->rear + 1) % MAXSIZE == q->front; }

void ca_enqueue(CAQueue *q, int val) {
    if (ca_full(q)) { printf("Full\n"); return; }
    q->rear = (q->rear + 1) % MAXSIZE;
    q->data[q->rear] = val;
}

int ca_dequeue(CAQueue *q) {
    if (ca_empty(q)) return -1;
    q->front = (q->front + 1) % MAXSIZE;
    return q->data[q->front];
}

int main() {
    printf("=== Queue Implementations Demo ===\n\n");

    // Linked List Queue
    printf("1. Linked List Queue:\n");
    LLQueue llq; ll_init(&llq);
    ll_enqueue(&llq, 10); ll_enqueue(&llq, 20); ll_enqueue(&llq, 30);
    printf("Dequeue: %d\n", ll_dequeue(&llq));  // 10
    ll_enqueue(&llq, 40);
    while (!ca_empty((CAQueue*)&llq))  // Hack: reuse empty check
        printf("Dequeue: %d\n", ll_dequeue(&llq));

    // Circular Array Queue
    printf("\n2. Circular Array Queue (size 5):\n");
    CAQueue caq; ca_init(&caq);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 4; i++) ca_enqueue(&caq, i*10);
    printf("Enqueued 10,20,30,40\n");
    ca_enqueue(&caq, 50);  // Fills last slot
    ca_enqueue(&caq, 60);  // Should say "Full"
    printf("Dequeue all: ");
    while (!ca_empty(&caq))
        printf("%d ", ca_dequeue(&caq));
    printf("\n");

    return 0;
}

// pq_comparison.c - Priority Queue All 4 Implementations
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define MAXSIZE 100

typedef struct { int job_no, priority; } Job;

typedef struct node { Job job; struct node *next; } Node;
typedef struct { Node *front, *rear; } PQList;

// Helper
Node* create_node(Job j) {
    Node *n = (Node*)malloc(sizeof(Node));
    n->job = j; n->next = NULL;
    return n;
}

// ===== 1. Unordered List =====
void ulist_init(PQList *q) { q->front = q->rear = NULL; }

void ulist_enqueue(PQList *q, Job j) {
    Node *n = create_node(j);
    if (!q->rear) q->front = q->rear = n;
    else { q->rear->next = n; q->rear = n; }
}

Job ulist_dequeue(PQList *q) {
    Node *max_p = NULL, *max_c = q->front, *p = NULL, *c = q->front;
    int max_pri = c->job.priority;
    while (c) {
        if (c->job.priority > max_pri) {
            max_pri = c->job.priority; max_p = p; max_c = c;
        }
        p = c; c = c->next;
    }
    Job job = max_c->job;
    if (!max_p) q->front = max_c->next;
    else max_p->next = max_c->next;
    if (!max_c->next) q->rear = max_p;
    free(max_c);
    return job;
}

// ===== 2. Ordered List =====
void olist_enqueue(PQList *q, Job j) {
    Node *n = create_node(j);
    if (!q->front || q->front->job.priority <= j.priority) {
        n->next = q->front; q->front = n;
        if (!q->rear) q->rear = n;
    } else {
        Node *c = q->front;
        while (c->next && c->next->job.priority > j.priority) c = c->next;
        n->next = c->next; c->next = n;
        if (!n->next) q->rear = n;
    }
}

Job olist_dequeue(PQList *q) {
    Job j = q->front->job;
    Node *t = q->front;
    q->front = t->next;
    if (!q->front) q->rear = NULL;
    free(t);
    return j;
}

// ===== 3. Unordered Array =====
typedef struct { Job jobs[MAXSIZE]; int n; } PQArray;

void uarr_init(PQArray *q) { q->n = 0; }
void uarr_enqueue(PQArray *q, Job j) {
    if (q->n < MAXSIZE) q->jobs[q->n++] = j;
}

Job uarr_dequeue(PQArray *q) {
    int max_i = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < q->n; i++)
        if (q->jobs[i].priority > q->jobs[max_i].priority) max_i = i;
    Job j = q->jobs[max_i];
    for (int i = max_i; i < q->n - 1; i++) q->jobs[i] = q->jobs[i+1];
    q->n--;
    return j;
}

// ===== 4. Ordered Array =====
void oarr_enqueue(PQArray *q, Job j) {
    int i = q->n - 1;
    while (i >= 0 && q->jobs[i].priority >= j.priority) {
        q->jobs[i+1] = q->jobs[i];
        i--;
    }
    q->jobs[i+1] = j; q->n++;
}

Job oarr_dequeue(PQArray *q) {
    return q->jobs[--q->n];
}

// Test
void test_pq(char *name, void (*enq)(void*,Job), Job (*deq)(void*), void *q) {
    Job jobs[] = {{1,10}, {2,30}, {3,20}, {4,5}, {5,25}};
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) enq(q, jobs[i]);
    printf("%s: ", name);
    while (1) {
        Job j = deq(q);
        if (j.job_no == 0 && j.priority == 0) break;  // Empty check needed
        printf("J%d(p%d) ", j.job_no, j.priority);
    }
    printf("\n");
}

int main() {
    printf("=== Priority Queue Comparison ===\n\n");

    // Note: Each implementation needs separate test due to different structures
    // This is a simplified demo

    // Unordered List
    PQList ulist; ulist_init(&ulist);
    Job jobs[] = {{1,10}, {2,30}, {3,20}, {4,5}, {5,25}};
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) ulist_enqueue(&ulist, jobs[i]);
    printf("Unordered List (Dequeue order): ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        Job j = ulist_dequeue(&ulist);
        printf("J%d(p%d) ", j.job_no, j.priority);
    }
    printf("\n");

    // Ordered List
    PQList olist; ulist_init(&olist);  // Reuse init
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) olist_enqueue(&olist, jobs[i]);
    printf("Ordered List (Dequeue order):  ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        Job j = olist_dequeue(&olist);
        printf("J%d(p%d) ", j.job_no, j.priority);
    }
    printf("\n");

    // Unordered Array
    PQArray uarr; uarr_init(&uarr);
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) uarr_enqueue(&uarr, jobs[i]);
    printf("Unordered Array (Dequeue):       ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        Job j = uarr_dequeue(&uarr);
        printf("J%d(p%d) ", j.job_no, j.priority);
    }
    printf("\n");

    // Ordered Array
    PQArray oarr; uarr_init(&oarr);
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) oarr_enqueue(&oarr, jobs[i]);
    printf("Ordered Array (Dequeue):         ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        Job j = oarr_dequeue(&oarr);
        printf("J%d(p%d) ", j.job_no, j.priority);
    }
    printf("\n");

    return 0;
}

Search
items.text:
node_t* search(node_t *root, int key) {
    if (!root || root->key == key) return root;
    if (key < root->key) return search(root->left, key);
    return search(root->right, key);
}

items.title: Insert
items.text:
node_t* insert(node_t *root, int key) {
    if (!root) {
        node_t *n = malloc(sizeof(node_t));
        n->key = key; n->left = n->right = NULL;
        return n;
    }
    if (key < root->key)
        root->left = insert(root->left, key);
    else
        root->right = insert(root->right, key);
    return root;
}

items.title: Delete (4 Cases)
items.text:
node_t* delete(node_t *root, int key) {
    if (!root) return NULL;

    if (key < root->key)
        root->left = delete(root->left, key);
    else if (key > root->key)
        root->right = delete(root->right, key);
    else {  // Found!
        // Case 1: Leaf
        if (!root->left && !root->right) {
            free(root); return NULL;
        }
        // Case 2: Only right child
        if (!root->left) {
            node_t *t = root->right; free(root); return t;
        }
        // Case 3: Only left child
        if (!root->right) {
            node_t *t = root->left; free(root); return t;
        }
        // Case 4: Two children - use inorder successor
        node_t *succ = root->right;
        while (succ->left) succ = succ->left;
        root->key = succ->key;
        root->right = delete(root->right, succ->key);
    }
    return root;
}

Case 4 Explanation: Replace with inorder successor (smallest in right subtree), then delete that successor.

int insert_rec(node_t e[], int root, int new_idx) {
    if (root == -1) return new_idx;
    if (e[root].key > e[new_idx].key)
        e[root].left = insert_rec(e, e[root].left, new_idx);
    else
        e[root].right = insert_rec(e, e[root].right, new_idx);
    return root;
}

void insert(tree_t *t, int key) {
    int idx = t->count++;
    t->elem[idx].key = key;
    t->elem[idx].left = t->elem[idx].right = -1;
    t->root = insert_rec(t->elem, t->root, idx);
}

items.title: Build from Postfix
items.text:
node_t* build_expression_tree(char *postfix) {
    node_t *stack[100];
    int top = -1;

    for (int i = 0; postfix[i]; i++) {
        char ch = postfix[i];
        if (isdigit(ch)) {
            // Operand: create node, push
            node_t *n = malloc(sizeof(node_t));
            n->key = ch; n->left = n->right = NULL;
            stack[++top] = n;
        } else {
            // Operator: pop 2, create node, push
            node_t *n = malloc(sizeof(node_t));
            n->key = ch;
            n->right = stack[top--];  // First popped = right
            n->left = stack[top--];   // Second popped = left
            stack[++top] = n;
        }
    }
    return stack[top];  // Root
}
